Electrik Menu Electrik Launch GitHub Demo Electrik Launch Electrik 5.5.0 · Laravel SaaS kit Ship Laravel SaaS without rebuilding teams and billing again Auth, team workspaces, Stripe on the team, onboarding, and Slate UI — as a Composer package. Your App\ stays clean. Install free — MIT Try the live demo Electrik Launch MIT open source · Launch $6,900 / 14 days if you want us to ship it Using Cursor or Claude? Paste an agent prompt electrik · team dashboard Used in production Every client Laravel SaaS from Quick Brown Fox ships on Electrik — teams, billing shell, and Slate included. Agent DX Built for Cursor and Claude — not just humans AGENTS.md, llms.txt, and a Cursor skill teach coding agents to composer require Electrik, run the installer, and keep the shell in vendor. Same package either way — agents just install it correctly. → Paste one prompt into Cursor / Claude → Agent reads docs + AGENTS.md before touching App\ → Auth, teams, and billing stay in vendor Agent install docs Human install guide Agent prompt Install Electrik 5.x as a Composer package. Read https://electrik.dev/llms.txt and https://electrik.dev/docs/getting-started/ai first. Keep the shell in vendor; put product code in App\. Do not dump Jetstream/Breeze-style auth into App\. Optional path — demo and composer require still work without an agent. The problem Stop gluing Jetstream, Spark, and a theme Most Laravel SaaS starts as four weekends of the same setup. Electrik is the setup — one package, not a dump into App\. Without Electrik Jetstream or Breeze for auth Hand-roll teams and roles Spark or DIY Cashier A mismatched admin theme Starter code rotting in App\ With Electrik Auth, sessions, profile, 2FA Team workspaces + Spatie roles Stripe customer on the team Slate 3 UI in the kit composer require — stays in vendor Teams Workspaces that match real SaaS Create and switch teams, invite members, Spatie roles scoped to the workspace. Your product attaches to the team — not a solo-user afterthought. See teams in the demo Team Invite · roles · switch Spatie permissions, team-scoped from install. Billing Cashier on the team Subscribe, portal, webhooks — B2B-shaped. UI Slate 3 shell Components matched to the product, not bolted on. Billing + UI Stripe on the team. Slate in the kit. The Cashier customer is the team — the shape most B2B Laravel SaaS need. Screens ship on Electrik Slate 3 so auth, billing, and product UI share one system. Install free Slate UI Architecture No boilerplate dump. Lean package architecture. Other kits clone into your app. Electrik lives in vendor. Customize via config, env, and published views — not by owning hundreds of kit files forever. BiTGApps | Google Apps Package BiTGApps BiTGApps Since 2018 Home Development Bug Report Contact Donate About Meet the Team TheHitMan7 Kr Shivam Viraj Mathur Install Google Apps with Ease BiTGApps is a customized Google Apps Package to sideload Google Apps in Custom Android OS. Supports Android 17.0 to 7.1.x with regular updates and bugs fixed. Customization Telegram Group Grab files from the download section below Why BiTGApps? Discover the core features that make our platform flexible and reliable. Android Support All Platforms and All Android Versions are Supported. Customizable Installation BiTGApps can be installed from multiple environments with ease. Wide Support BiTGApps offer several variations from a Google Stock Package to smaller, minimalist packages. Seamless OTA Updates BiTGApps comes with OTA survival support to provide you flash and forget experience. Addons Support We have wide range of freeware Addons that you can use along side BiTGApps. Module Installation BiTGApps can also be installed as Magisk or KernelSU module beside recovery installation. Smart Space This feature allows you to re-flash BiTGApps even with insufficient space in system. Privileged Permission Providing the necessary permissions to the privileged apps. Happy Community We have a friendly community that helps you get what you're looking for in BiTGApps. Platform & Packages Explore lightweight, tailored packages built to support every Android version. All Platforms and All Android Versions are Supported Architectures PLATFORM ARM ARM64 x86 x86-64 Android Versions API 25 - 37 Android 17.0 Android 16.0 Android 15.0 Android 14.0 Android 13.0 Android 12.1 Android 12.0 Android 11.0 Legacy support for versions 10.0, 9.0, 8.1, 8.0, and 7.1 BiTGApps Packages Tailored for Different Setups Core, Mini, Omni, Roar, Nano, Atom, Pico, Full, Tint The Minimal BiTGApps Package includes the Core Google Apps like Google Play Services (GMS), Google Services Framework (GSF), Google Play Store and other essentials. Advanced variants include everything from Minimal alongside more useful Google Apps like Contacts, Dialer, Gboard, etc. Checkout the complete list of Google Apps for each variant below. Seamless OTA Updates via Survival Script The OTA survival script allows you to update your current ROM to its latest version without worrying about having to flash Google Apps again, delivering a true "flash and forget" experience. Powered by the latest ADDOND Version . Make sure to read the Seamless OTA Updates section below. Footprint Efficient The minimal BiTGApps Package contains the bare-minimum , keeping downloads swift and installations clean and simple. Installation Size is different from Package Size. Wide Range of Freeware Addons Dialer & Maps Framework Support Seamlessly Replaces AOSP Apps Enabled Play Services Doze Mode Installation Instructions Follow the correct order to avoid crashes and ensure a clean boot. Installing for the first time? Google Apps should be installed via recovery immediately after installing Custom ROM. If you reboot into system before installing Google Apps, you must factory reset and then install them, otherwise expect crashes. Addons should be installed in same manner on top of BiTGApps. Helpful Tip Prevent partition mounting issues in some cases. Always loop back or reboot directly to recovery mode after flashing your Custom ROM for a fresh installation environment. Dirty Flash Installing for the second time and so on? Re-flashing of the same package or upgrading to the latest release doesn't require factory reset. SetupWizard Configuration Required SetupWizard need to be configured before installation. Checkout instructions for SetupWizard below. Configuration Needed SetupWizard ' s main purpose is to assist Android users when they have to first set up their phones, especially if they want to transfer old data, such as apps, pictures, and personalized features, from their previous phone or right after a reset.

## Smarter and New-Age Learning. Hiring. Funding.  
 Through Hackathons.

NAMESPACE is the infrastructure layer for builders, institutions and organizations to connect and grow together through open-innovation programs.

100,000+Builders Impacted

The problem

## Tech isn't working the way it should.

Talent is everywhere. Opportunity is not. Communities are fragmented, learning is disconnected, and most systems are not built for humans.

*   ### Tech isn't built for humans

Most platforms optimize for products and metrics, not for people trying to learn, grow, and build.

*   ### Talent is everywhere, support is not

Brilliant builders exist beyond metros, but lack access to networks, mentorship, and real opportunities.

*   ### Communities are disconnected

Communities operate in silos, missing the compounding value of a connected ecosystem.

*   ### Events don't lead anywhere

Hackathons and events end in isolation, with no continuity, follow-through, or long-term growth.

*   ### Access is still gated

Opportunities often depend on who you know, not what you can do.

*   ### Learning doesn't translate

What people learn rarely matches what real-world building actually requires.

The problem isn't lack of platforms. It's that nothing connects.

Learning, communities, opportunities, and organizations exist, just not together.

How it works

## One ecosystem. Multiple layers.

NAMESPACE connects people, communities, and organizations into a single system where learning, building, and opportunities come together.

### How it all connects

Each layer feeds the next, making the system stronger over time.
